name: Silent Handover — C. Continuity checks (every 5 minutes)

parameters.content:
## Workflow C — Unresolved issue continuity

The database does the work (`internal.scheduled_tick()`):
- AI requests with no result after the timeout are failed and retried, then sent to manual review.
- Active issues with no update for N hours are escalated to supervisors (once per period of inactivity).
- Reporting windows that closed without a submission alert the supervisor.
- Analysis inputs past their retention period are deleted.

Issues are never closed because a later report did not mention them. Replace the URL with your API. Use this instead of the API's internal scheduler when the API runs serverless (set ENABLE_INTERNAL_SCHEDULER=false).
